notes.title: 2.1.3 Knights & Zoom Fixes Patch
notes.content:
Monarchs, 

As per our commitment to making sure your continued reign is as smooth and enjoyable as possible (excluding the attacks at night by you-know-who), we’re releasing the following update to your kingdom: 
[list]
[*] We took the knights through rigorous training to fix some errant behavior, as reported to us by our players. The training regimen included a refreshment of protocols regarding protecting their assigned archers, not abandoning a fight just because they take a hit or two, attacking portals and cave spawners, and retreating after the cave portal has been temporarily destroyed.  
[*] Fixed an issue in multiplayer that would cause the client’s coins to get stuck in mid-air when attempting to make a payment. 
[*] Fixed an issue in multiplayer that would cause currency to disappear from the client’s coin bag when sailing away or changing game modes. 
[*] Resolved a caching issue which could cause unintentional PlayFab account sharing. 
[*] After your feedback, we’ve decided to revert one of the QoL changes from patch 2.0: Player 2 dropping the coins from their coin bag on the ground when they disconnect. The coins will now stay in Player 2’s coin bag and become available when Player 2 reconnects, the same way it worked before the patch. However, gems and quest items will continue to be automatically transported to Player 1’s coin bag, to avoid soft lock scenarios. 
[*] Restored the larger range of zoom levels on supported resolutions and made sure art assets fit the screen properly.  
[*] The audio in the splash screens will now play correctly when you start a new campaign or Challenge Island in an ongoing session. 
[*] Players can once again see color changes while randomizing the Monarch’s appearance in the loading screen. 
[*] The Cursed Crown will now display correctly on the Trojan Monarch. 
[*] The bomb is now the top priority of your workers. Workers pushing the bomb now won’t abandon it so easily in pursuit of other jobs. Additionally, when called to the boat by the wharf bell, the workers that were originally pushing the bomb won’t block other workers from taking over their bomb duties. 
[*] [b]Challenge Islands:[/b] Fixed an issue that could cause some players to experience a soft lock in multiplayer while sailing to the next island. 
[*] [b]Call of Olympus:[/b] Coin slots should now be visible for all mount locations in local co-op. 
[*] [b]Norse Lands:[/b] Archers in towers will no longer call dibs on shields in the Shield Shop, making them available for other units to pick up. 
[*] [b]Norse Lands: [/b]Workers will now seek safety behind the Kingdom walls a bit faster. 
[*] [b]Norse Lands:[/b] Improved visual effects on fire effects related to the Fire Tower. 
[*] Fixed minor visual and functional issues. 
[/list]
This bugfix patch is part of our ongoing efforts to ensure the quality and smooth Monarch experience for Kingdom Two Crowns. Thank you for consistently sending your reports – we continue investigating them and developing further fixes.  

If you encounter an issue that has not been patched yet, please report it at https://rawfury.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1 This is the quickest way for us to have a look at what might be going wrong with your reign and help. 

Thank you for your patience, Monarchs, & long may you reign! 👑

notes.title: Patch notes Kingdom Two Crowns 2.1.2
notes.content:
Monarchs,

This patch contains several bug fixes, improvements to memory performance and to networking including:

[list]
[*] Fixed the issue that would cause Hephaestus' hammer quest item to disappear from the level in multiplayer, blocking your progress. If your save file was affected, loading the save on the new patch will automatically complete the quest and grant you the reward.
[*] Fixed the issue that prevented the achievement Mediterranean Vacation from unlocking at the right time. Unfortunately, the achievement can not be unlocked retroactively on save files that were encountering this issue. To get it, the requirements must be met again in a fresh campaign.
[*] Optimized networking and reduced traffic to improve online co-op experience.
[*] Fixed several issues that could cause crashes to occur in specific gameplay scenarios.
[*] Fixed the issue that would sometimes cause ruler animations to break when starting a co-op session.
[*] Fixed the issue that would cause the client player’s movement to break while riding the Hippocampus.
[*] Fixed the issue where the boar re-spawning in wintertime would have the game consider the island as incomplete. If you give any lingering threats a good whack in this patch, it should do the trick and the island status will stay as "completed".
[*] Shield Walls in Norse Lands should now block Crushers correctly.
[*] Archers following a Squire or Knight should no longer be left outside the safety of the Kingdom walls at night.
[*] Archers on the Fleet boats should now attack Serpent weak points correctly.
[*] Farmers who have boarded a boat will no longer occupy farmlands.
[*] Fixed minor visual and audio issues.
[*] The zoom levels have been temporarily capped to prevent issues with environment graphics, while we are working on a bigger fix to preserve graphic integrity at more zoomed out levels for a future patch.
[/list]
We'd like to take a moment and thank those of you who have tested the multiplayer public beta and confirmed the networking performance has improved. We will now end the public beta, so everyone in it will be automatically reverted back to the default branch which now, after this patch, has the same fixes.

We will continue to patch the game with more bugfixes as soon as possible. 

As before, we always communicate updates on our X, Facebook and Discord, so please make sure you follow them to stay on track with the latest news. If you encounter any further issues, please report them at https://rawfury.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1 as this is the quickest way for us to investigate and get back to you.

Thank you for your continuous support. 

/The Kingdom Team

notes.title: 🎮Dev Update - Multiplayer Fixes🎮
notes.content:
Monarchs,

The team is now back from the holidays and our annual internal conference where we spent a lot of time planning. We will share more on that later, but for now we would like to focus on fixing and addressing some of the multiplayer issues identified in the game. We have implemented and tested a series of these fixes and would like to invite the community to participate in a public beta test for additional feedback. We deeply appreciate everyone's patience as we keep developing and implementing fixes to issues in the game.

Please note that this solution is still in testing - however, if it helps you, please do let us know in the comments. Some questions that could help would be - is it stable? Are there any unexpected disconnects? Is the connection reliable? Is there a lag? If it plays well for you, we'll be working on patching the game as soon as possible, so that you could start enjoying the multiplayer fully.

To access the beta, please follow these steps:

1. Go to your Steam Library
2. Right click on Kingdom Two Crowns -> Properties -> Betas
3. In the list of betas, please select "public-test - Multiplayer fixes to version 2.1.0 (Feb 25)"
4. Enjoy!

[u] Important[/u] - please make sure that your play partner is also playing the beta, and that you've made a backup of your saves before installing the update.

[h3]These are the fixes we've made in the public beta[/h3]
With the goal of eliminating multiplayer issues and disconnects that players have reported, we have taken a good hard look at our networking code and found ways to reduce the overall network overhead. Our networking now uses less additional data to identify messages and state their purpose. We have also increased the timeout duration for connections meaning it will stick in there longer when you experience lag spikes or connectivity issues. We deployed some advanced optimization heuristics on our most common message types to also reduce the actual amount of data being sent. Along with the already optimized overhead, these two put together result in up to 40% less traffic. Finally we implemented some Steam specific optimizations to better utilize the Steam P2P networking API, minimizing external overhead and fixing a potential bottleneck.

/The Kingdom Team

notes.title: Patch notes Kingdom Two Crowns 2.1.0
notes.content:
Monarchs,

Thank you for your patience as we've been working hard to identify, investigate and develop fixes for the issues you have reported. We have now published a major patch addressing the following bugs: 

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause the players to lose the required souls for the Hermes Quest in certain multiplayer situations.
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause the Cerberus head items to duplicate infinitely, filling up the coin pouch.
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause Persephone to disappear forever or escape to other islands.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented players from paying for the attack on the Serpent's weak point in split screen co-op.
[*] Fixed an issue that would cause a black screen when launching the game on Mac. If you are experiencing this issue after downloading the latest update, try restarting the game once OR exit and enter full screen once by using Command + Control + F (Big Sur and earlier) or Fn + F (Monterey or later), and the problem should be solved.
[*] Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause mount abilities to be unusable until the player changes to another mount.
[*] Fixed a damage bug with Pikemen and Hoplites that would cause them to do less than intended damage against high health enemies. 
[*] Fixed several issues with Knight behavior when interacting with the Serpent, including situations where they would stop moving entirely.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented islands in Call of Olympus from being registered as completed properly, causing decay to happen when it should not.
[*] Fixed several Norse Lands mounts' abilities not triggering pushback effect correctly.
[*] Fixed several issues with unit behavior when they interacted with Persephone’s cage, including Knights running past it.
[*] Workers will no longer run indefinitely to one side after their work gets destroyed.
[*] Breeders will no longer hit units standing behind walls.
[*] Floaters will no longer get stuck on walls.
[*] Fleet boats will now join a player bearing the banner even if there is no squad present.
[*] Squads will no longer jump off the ship when the player tries to sail away.
[*] Tweaked Greed portal behavior to not activate at inappropriate times.
[*] Lowered the spawn rate of Greed portal defense waves at lower difficulty settings.
[*] Fixed an issue that would cause the achievement “Master of the Sea” to trigger incorrectly.
[*] Fixed malfunctioning camera movement that would happen after destroying the caves in the Skull Island challenge.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented players from selecting their preferred ruler in the Lost Islands challenge.
[*] Fixed an issue that would cause the game to freeze if the player turns off the tutorial in Challenge Islands.
[*] Fixed the Cursed Crown placement on most Royal Wardrobe ruler skins.
[*] Fixed an issue that would show incorrect island completion values in the save slots.
[*] Fixed an issue that would show incorrect gem and portal values on the map.
[*] Fixed some text strings flowing outside of the visible area during split screen co-op.
[*] Addressed several visual issues with sprites, VFX, and UI.
[*] Addressed several visual and sync issues in multiplayer.
[/list]
With this patch we have resolved a wide number of issues that you have identified and we are still investigating a few more. We're committed to making Kingdom a high quality experience, and are therefore continuously at work on improving it. We always communicate updates on our X, Facebook and Discord, so please make sure you follow them not to miss any. If you encounter any further issues, please report them at https://rawfury.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1 as this is the quickest way for us to have a look and get back to you.

notes.title: Call of Olympus, Kingdom 2.0 and Royal Wardrobe DLCs are now available!
notes.content:
“A hero must be wary at all times. Hear the call of the Oracle as she draws you towards your fated destiny, but do not be swayed from your quest by the siren calls of the dark light...”

Call of Olympus is out now! Take back Mount Olympus in this major expansion for Kingdom Two Crowns set in a world inspired by ancient Greece. Embark on a quest to win the favor of the gods and defend your Kingdom versus the Greed with powerful artifacts and units. 

[previewyoutube=4BCaanQTroc;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]A Quest to Free Mount Olympus[/b]
[list]
[*] An Epic New World: Call of Olympus features a reworked map with an epic conclusion at Mount Olympus, and you choose how to get there!
[*] Temple and Quest Islands: These new islands present unique challenges, hidden treasures and powerful artifact rewards - prove your worth to Artemis, Athena, Hephaestus and Hermes to open the path to Mount Olympus.
[*] Mythological mounts: Discover and unlock powerful new mounts, like the fierce three-headed Cerberus, the terrifying fire-breathing Chimera, the majestic winged Pegasus, or the trusty Donkey… and many more!
[/list]
[b]Fight Greed of Epic Scales[/b]
[list]
[*] Face Your Fears: Muster steadfast defences to protect your crown, the Greed threat is more challenging than ever before, with multi-phased boss battles against the sinister Serpent.
[*] Raise Your Banner: Shift the momentum and lead from the front. Bring the fight to the Greed with new siege mechanics, where the Hoplites will join you in Phalanx formation.
[*] Assemble Your Fleet: Fight on land and at sea - build a fleet with devastating ship-mounted ballistas to join your battle. Once victorious, use your armada to ferry your army across the seas and combat the growing threat of Greed.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Powerful Artifacts: Unlock four unique artifacts bestowed by the gods. Whether you choose a bow with a powerful directed attack, or a hammer that boosts your troops’ prowess, these items grant you new offensive and defensive abilities against the Greed.
[*] Guided by the Oracle: Never stray from the task at hand. At your request,the Oracle will provide you with wisdom and directions for the next step of your Odyssey!
[*] Set the Greed Ablaze: Wield powerful fire technology granted by the new hermit. It's as if it was gifted by Prometheus himself!

[h3]Last but not least... Let’s kick off the Coronation Week![/h3]
We are celebrating everything Kingdom on all fronts, we will share more information on how to join the festivities soon... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/a27e9735155eec9800b542b6babeb22b307379d5.gif[/img]

notes.title: Development Blog #8: Kingdom Two Crowns Free 2.0 update & Royal Wardrobe DLCs
notes.content:
With the release of Call of Olympus NEXT WEEK (excitement!) we’re also giving the Kingdom Two Crowns base game a 2.0 update. There's loads of quality-of-life updates, and those will be free for everyone who owns Kingdom Two Crowns, regardless of whether you purchase Call of Olympus or not. Some of the improvements we’ve already talked about (like more save slots and the option to disable the tutorial ghost!) but for this blog post we're inviting you to dive a little deeper into the details with one of our programmers, Danijel. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/839894350cdffeb132f51c97b0e2db43fe2767f4.jpg[/img]
[i]With the 2.0 update of Kingdom Two Crowns we have re-envisioned the visual representation of the game. Can you spot all the details?[/i]

[h3]Hi, I’m Danijel. Let me introduce you to Kingdom Two Crowns 2.0![/h3]
There are many improvements coming to KTC with the 2.0 update (see a longer list further down below) but here are some of my favorites!
[list]
[*]Archers, knights and pikemen will no longer guard a side of your kingdom, if it is completely safe! Instead, they will rush to the other side and help where it is still needed. But don't worry, a few archers will still stay behind and hunt so you don't lose your income. 
[*]Talking of smarter units, the archers also realized they don't have infinite range and it does not help anyone, if they occupy towers deep within the kingdom. You can now build towers close to your keep without worrying that the archers will take up permanent residence inside, and be unavailable when you need them once the kingdom is expanded. As walls are built and torn down, archers will now only occupy the towers within reasonable distance from the walls. 
[*]If you found it hard to guess how much health a beach portal has remaining, you were not alone. Unlike forest portals which slowly crumble to let you know, beach portals were impossible to read. But no more! They have now grown little pustules which pop as they take damage, and once all pustules are gone the portal falls. 
[*]If you enjoy playing multiplayer and admire the nature in Kingdom, you may appreciate this one: we greatly improved the multiplayer syncing of both the kinds of trees and bushes, as well as foliage colors and states of trees and bushes as they change colors, lose and regrow leaves with the change of seasons. So, you and your play partner can enjoy the same view when standing next to each other in multiplayer. 
[*]We also fixed some annoyances, for example we now apply your saved sound settings during the boot-up sequence. So, if you are used to playing Kingdom with low volume, you don't get blasted by the sound. 
[*]Ninjas in Shogun were too fond of their hiding spots and could hide in their old spot within your walls where encountering the Greed is unlikely. Or they would hide in plain sight once their favourite bamboo tree was cut down. This is no longer the case. 
[*]You can now interact with a mount that walks towards a stable. You don’t need to wait for it to arrive there anymore! 
[*]Islands where you completely eradicated the Greed no longer decay. Yay! 
[*]If archers retreating from a fallen wall pass by an empty tower, they will take shelter and shoot the Greed there. 
[/list]
Some funny bugs that we fixed: 
[list]
[*]The rabbits in O&B no longer play chicken sounds for P2 while in multiplayer. 
[*]The rider on the loading screen now gallops with the steed when loading is complete. 
[*]You can no longer change the difficulty while looking at the peaceful difficulty confirmation.  
[*]P2 can now see the difficulty of the game they joined in multiplayer, instead of labeling everything normal.
[*]In multiplayer, P2 will now also hear the wonderful flute the Shogun merchant plays when dropping coins. 
[*]While hunting or defending, if an archer shoots the rope holding a Monarch cage in Deadlands without having the player pay for it, it is now accounted for! Lucky shot indeed. 
[/list]
[h3]This and much more will be available on October 8th for all of our players. Thanks, Danijel, for letting us peek behind the curtain to see what you and the rest of the team has been up to! [/h3]

[h3]The Kingdom Two Crowns 2.0 patch notes in detail:[/h3]
[list]
[*]The new save slot system lets you create up to 10 save slots. Your existing save files will be automatically converted to the new system and keep your progress intact.  
[*]The new campaign select flow will give you a better overview when you select your preferred difficulty mode and ruler. It will also showcase the new ruler skins available through the Royal Wardrobe DLC’s, also launching alongside this patch! 
[*]Added an option to disable the tutorial ghost. The ghost is also a bit less intrusive while it is enabled. However, the Oracle will still show up for certain events in Call of Olympus even with the tutorial ghost disabled, as the Oracle is a part of the story!  
[*]Improved the level generation of the game. Walls, farms, and towers are now placed more evenly and with higher priority around the levels. Trees and bushes will overlap less with other structures. Shop placement has also been worked on, and should result in more reliable shop generation and less overlapping structures at the edge of your Kingdom. 
[*]The winter season has been rebalanced to match your chosen difficulty level, making easier modes easier and (you guessed it) harder modes harder. Critters will spawn occasionally from the bushes, the number of berry bushes will depend on the difficulty, and the boar will spawn further from your Kingdom walls.  
[*]Greed portals will be more reactive to your presence, and their defense waves will scale with the length of the current campaign. 
[*]The offensive units have gone through mandatory training for defending your Kingdom where there is actual danger. This means that if one side of the level is clear of portals and threats, all units will focus on defending the side of your Kingdom that is still endangered. 
[*]Had a chat with the worker units about their downtime behavior - they will now spread out more evenly throughout your Kingdom to await your next command!  
[*]When citizens drop coins, they throw them in your movement direction instead of just dropping them on the ground. 
[*]All mounts will now clearly show when they have finished feeding and regained their stamina sparkles. 
[*]The bear mount has gotten an overhaul in all biomes where it can be found. We’ve lowered the cost and made improvements to its movement and stamina, and tweaked its attacks. It now regains a small bit of stamina whenever it hits another animal.  
[*]Did a balance pass on the difficulty modes - harder modes now have a higher difficulty. Good luck!  
[*]Improved VFX and lighting systems, which will improve both the visual look and the performance of the game. 
[*]Added an overview of the game’s control scheme in the options menu 
[*]And LOTS more! 
[/list]
[h3]A Wardrobe fit for a Monarch[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/4a35b1f9c4b7fcac56b94268429616c04fc2210a.gif[/img]
We’ve created a new way to support the future development of Kingdom and we’re calling this The Royal Wardrobe – it is a new option in Kingdom Two Crowns that offers new looks for your Monarch. We’ve put together a total of six new skins, inspired by both the original Medieval setting and the new ancient Greece-themed setting. You can however use them in all settings, except for Dead Lands (since in that one the Monarchs are named characters!). The skins are purely cosmetic with no extra in-game functionality. Rather it’s an additional means for players to support the future development of Kingdom. We did allow ourselves to be a bit sillier with this one than we usually are, especially with the Trojan Monarch. We hope you’ll like this very genuine and real Monarch as much as we do! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/9e56d3123a76d524168e256afac27d458aca99ca.png[/img]

[h3]Thank you, our dear community, for journeying with us on the road to the release! We can’t wait to share the joys of Call of Olympus with you on October 8th🔥 [/h3]

See our previous dev blogs to find out more about Call of Olympus from the developers:

notes.content:
Kingdom Two Crowns: Call of Olympus is a major expansion for Kingdom Two Crowns. Set out and build your Kingdom, in a completely new setting featuring legends and mythos inspired by ancient Greece. Set sail for faraway islands on the 8th of October!

[previewyoutube=Fsx2lMf-A98;full][/previewyoutube]
Call of Olympus includes:
[h2]A Quest to Free Mount Olympus[/h2]

- [b]An Epic New World[/b]: Call of Olympus features a reworked map with an epic conclusion at Mount Olympus, and you choose how to get there!
- [b]Temple and Quest Islands[/b]: These new islands present unique challenges, hidden treasures and powerful artifact rewards - prove your worth to Artemis, Athena, Hephaestus and Hermes to open the path to Mount Olympus.
- [b]Mythological mounts[/b]: Discover and unlock powerful new mounts, like the fierce three-headed Cerberus, the terrifying fire-breathing Chimera, the majestic winged Pegasus, or the trusty Donkey… and many more!

[h2]Fight Greed of Epic Scales[/h2]

- [b]Face Your Fears[/b]: Muster steadfast defences to protect your crown, the Greed threat is more challenging than ever before, with multi-phased boss battles against the sinister Serpent.
- [b]Raise Your Banner[/b]: Shift the momentum and lead from the front. Bring the fight to the Greed with new siege mechanics, where the Hoplites will join you in Phalanx formation.
- [b]Assemble Your Fleet[/b]: Fight on land and at sea - build a fleet with devastating ship-mounted ballistas to join your battle. Once victorious, use your armada to ferry your army across the seas and combat the growing threat of Greed.

[h2]Discover Godly Powers and Abilities[/h2]

- [b]Powerful Artifacts[/b]: Unlock four unique artifacts bestowed by the gods. Whether you choose a bow with a powerful directed attack, or a hammer that boosts your troops’ prowess, these items grant you new offensive and defensive abilities against the Greed.
- [b]Guided by the Oracle[/b]: Never stray from the task at hand. At your request,the Oracle will provide you with wisdom and directions for the next step of your Odyssey!
- [b]Set the Greed Ablaze[/b]: Wield powerful fire technology granted by the new hermit. It's as if it was gifted by Prometheus himself!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2736340/Kingdom_Two_Crowns_Call_of_Olympus/

Detailed patch notes will follow. 

Finally, we are excited to announce that we are launching two brand-new cosmetic DLCs: Regent's & Archon's Royal Wardrobe! These new supporter pack DLCs provide no additional gameplay features, it is in short, a completely optional way for you to spice up your campaign and at the same time help and support us to work on new cool things for the Kingdom series.

notes.title: Development Blog #6: Fight back
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/897bdccb45d7938d2e0ec43afbb381204991373e.png[/img]

Hey there it's time for a new development blog with yours truly, game director Angelica! First of all - I know many of you are excited about the upcoming release of Call of Olympus and want to know exactly WHEN you can jump on that ship to our favorite Greedified vacation destination. I won't be able to share a date today, but let's just say that we will be able to share a timeframe and some sort of news... tomorrow.

Let's dive into today's topic: boss fighting! You might have already spotted parts of our new Greed creature in the key art, so let's take a closer look at our slithering, hissing antagonist. This monumental Greed beast is truly a threat of epic scales!  

From the very beginning of this project, we knew we wanted something big. A foe never before seen in the world of Kingdom, something that would truly test our players. We just weren't sure what that might be. Then one day I got a ping from Valentina, one of our artists, who said "I have an idea!" (which you can see pictured below) and I just went "YES!". And that was it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/65ffb47703b30053e6e48e178068558f1caa04a4.png[/img]

Introducing a boss into Kingdom has been a new and exciting journey for our development team (with lots of prototyping and testing along the way!). I'm especially amazed at how our soundtrack composer Andreas Hald found ways to incorporate the music into the battle and absolutely nailed the feeling of a tug of war, where you constantly have to be on the lookout for danger while also keeping your eyes (and ears!) open for that opportunity to strike. Every enemy must have a weak point, right? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/331a3ef61de3deecd4e890c3c5322b20b2ed4cb0.gif[/img]
[i]What's in the water? In my base?! [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/6cbfe6aeed260bb215712e669479a711add93395.gif[/img]
[i]Sinister source... [/i]

[h3]FLEET BOATS  [/h3]

A major threat requires major weapons to fight. Not only will you have the new abilities in the game at your disposal, you will also have to utilize naval warfare to attack the beast from both land and water. With the new fleet mechanic, you'll be able to bring a small army of archers, ready to unleash a flurry of arrows from a ship that is sailing along with you as you charge into battle. At the very front of the ship you can see a mounted ballista, manned by one of your handy workers, sending those ballista bolts flying at the nearest target - causing devastating destruction in its wake! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/6acd0cd299d09a8c41e6fcf62574ec3f6db6b5a5.gif[/img]
[i]Your fleet will be able to support your troops versus the new great threat [/i]

Ahh, look at that crystal clear, vivid blue water. Almost wish you packed your bathing suit, huh? Except... now you know what dangers lurk in the depths below. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/5ec4353e0cb7f7d19357f2a446ee7c49eb225e80.png[/img]

[h3]🎆We can't wait to show you more soon. Very soon actually. To be more precise... How does tomorrow sound? Yeah, let's do that. Tune in tomorrow for a whole new trailer showing off heroic struggles of epic scales! notes.title: 👑Development Blog #5: Divine favors and treasures👑
notes.content:
Hey! Angelica here, we are back from the summer vacation and bringing you another update from the development team about the upcoming expansion Call of Olympus. In the last blog we talked about the gods and what their quests might look like. Today you'll be introduced to one of our fiery new mounts, get a hint of what wonderous rewards the gods may give, and gaze upon the blue flames of divinity. Hop aboard and let's set sail together! 

The journey to Mount Olympus will be a long and dangerous one, filled with heroic adventures and shining rewards beyond your imagination. The gods will be watching your every move, to see if you truly are the royal hero you claim to be. Will you be worthy of challenging the final enemy that looms at Mount Olympus? Or will your crown be lost to the mysterious Greed?  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/0b462fece5c59ef32bc30927da13d648fb0f5d21.jpg[/img]

To keep track of your progress, just gaze upon the giant marble columns standing tall in the distance. For each godly favor gained, the divine flames of the gods shall be lit. All four must be burning bright blue to open up the path to your true destiny. The end goal is clear, but the path you take to get there is up to you. Where shall you start? Do you set foot on the frozen lands that torture Athena? Or seek out the mysterious forest where Artemis' most desired treasure is hidden?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/a1d21bf6273bb3346141e114f40e1796d64255bc.gif[/img]

The choice is yours - but choose carefully! The gods will have very different challenges for you, and the rewards you may reap at the end of each will heavily impact how you play the game. Do you seek to wield the incandescent flames of a blazing volcano? Or would you rather see a storm of moonlight arrows rain down on your enemies? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/94c4530ce99532e693ba283385fc22e903b54881.gif[/img]

[h3][i]"She was of divine stock, not of men, in the fore part a lion, in the hinder a serpent, and in the midst a goat, breathing forth in terrible wise the might of blazing fire." [/i]

― Homer, The Iliad [/h3]

In the ancient myths, the Chimera was a fearsome and raging beast to be defeated by the hero in the story. But I  see myself as more of a "Yes, but can I pet it?" kind of person, so when we started exploring which mounts to include in this expansion, the Chimera immediately came to mind. Part lion, part goat, fire-breathing and with an amazing snake tail? Sign me up, I'm riding that thing! 

For the right prize, you'll be able to coax her out of her cave and bring the Chimera along on your travels as a steadfast and relentless mount: sharp claws, fiery jaws and all. Just make sure you let her have a snack once in a while! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/3e1e937c210d6a2a4c69baa500d574d5bcac7f7f.gif[/img]

That's all for today, folks. Keep your eyes peeled for more details about Kingdom Two Crowns: Call of Olympus. We will have more to share soon!

notes.title: ⚡Development Blog #2: Endless horizons⚡
notes.content:
[i]“Mysterious whispers, deep in nature's embrace 

An ancient threat awakens in this wondrous place” [/i]

Hey there, game director Angelica speaking. Things are starting to heat up over here! Even though the announcement was just a small glimpse of what's to come, we have been getting so much positive feedback from you all. We can't wait to share even more! 

While most of the team is very busy polishing those pixels to perfection and implementing new features (or ironing out a few nasty bugs)  I was still able to convince our talented artists to take a moment and share their progress in this environment-themed development blog. There will be plenty of time for us to talk about things like the campaign, divine quests and new features later on. For now, in order to tell this Odyssey of our development adventure, which in time will reveal completely new and bigger threats, I would like to start from the beginning with the foundation - the world. What does it take to bring our Greedified version of ancient Greece to life? 

[h2]Hello from the Mediterranean - greetings from the art team! [/h2]

More precisely, from sunny Croatia! Hello everybody, today you are greeted by some of the members of the art team. We are Sara and Valentina, and we will tell you a bit more about your Greek adventure in Kingdom Two Crowns. Living in Croatia was a huge plus for us while working on the Greece setting because we share some similarities with Greece, especially the natural coastal parts. Both of us could draw from our experiences of going to the seaside and capturing the natural beauty of this part of the Mediterranean.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/d4b8420f13e1386e66ab955b78f379621daa0c7f.gif[/img]

We couldn’t solely rely on our experiences, so when we started working on the new Kingdom biome, we first set out to gather plenty of references for anything ancient Greek- related. We brushed up on our art history, relearned Doric, Ionic, and Corinthian orders, pediments, triglyphs, metopes, etc. We did the same for the vegetation, googling all kinds of flora that were present in ancient Greece and tried to learn more about them: olives, pine trees, juniper trees, oleanders, laurels, asphodel plants, etc. If it was in ancient Greece, it would be added to the game. That led us to the new Kingdom look which should evoke the feeling of a Greedified Mediterranean vacation. You will find yourself exploring dry forests with those iconic cicada sounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/35d5f494ee47f10b5d58a33088fc5cc9e1712593.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/a2ec93cf1552383720a6604cf2c04618aee37f4c.png[/img]

In the midst of the Greek forests there are small patches of civilization left, the mysterious statues by which the ruler can make their subjects stronger and increase their chances of survival in the face of Greed. Inspired by lifelike statues of ancient Greece, we tried incorporating some classical poses like contrapposto and letting a wide variety of sculptures found in temple pediments influence the identity of our magical ones. One of my (Sara) favorite concepts was an archer statue inspired by the marble archer from the west pediment of Temple of Aphaia. (Un)fortunately, to resolve for more variety of units in this setting, sometimes things had to get cut like a Gordian knot. In place of the archer, what we needed was a slinger, so the archer sculpture got booted and replaced by this lil stone throwing guy. To blend these marble structures with the environment, we withered them down and covered them with Dionysion, or if you wanna be nasty, Ivy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/fee04f783de4ab68a1fa32877e02b332fec804ca.png[/img]

While working on nature for the game, we went for the “classics” of the Greek vegetation. We wanted the players to immediately sense that they are in a sunnier, slightly drier and coastal environment. Everything is a bit rockier, with bushes being more compact (except for the oleander bushes) and somewhat scarcer. We toyed with the idea of having foloi oak forest, but it detracted from the coastal look we were aiming for, so we decided to stick with the types of trees found near the coast.

This decision put us in a bit of a pickle because we lost our only deciduous tree, and as you all know, winter does come to the Kingdom. What is a dead giveaway for winter, you ask? Trees without leaves. So, we went on a hunt for an acceptable tree that would still feel coastal and shed its leaves, and we came up with the wild pear, or its grander name, Pyrus spinosa. By the end of working on all the trees, I (Valentina) developed a "professional disorder," as we say in Croatia, of checking out every single tree I see in real life and turning around just to gaze at it. It has become a joke at this point when I nudge Sara and say, "Hey, check out that good-looking canopy."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/443c552687ba4755b6b5511d53af05e547aef9ee.png[/img]

[h2]****[/h2]
We trust these glimpses into the enigmatic forests of Call of Olympus have stirred your spirit for the journey ahead. A loyal steed and a fiery torch shall be your steadfast companions as you venture into the verdant wilderness. Perhaps that mount is closer than you think? You just need to somehow figure out how to free it from its petrified prison.

Yet, be wary of the foreboding purple lights that shimmer along the winding path... who knows what wonders and trials lie in wait?

“Jingle, jingle…”🔔

Do you hear this lovely sound, Monarchs? 

It’s the delicate chime of the winter bells - which indicates that today is the first day of December! But, as the old legend goes, no December is merely a month in our beautiful Kingdom…

Noble Monarchs, prepare thine hearts, we invite you for this grand commencing - an event of unparalleled magnificence that shall usher in the season with merriment fit for royalty!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/cd705518746fcb620ad3b95b806e5d8aa9da622e.png[/img]
The gates swing wide open to reveal this figure-of-speech winter wonderland! All of Raw Fury games and the team behind them come together to celebrate each other and, as the Kingdom team, we would like to share some of our fireplace stories about personal experiences with creating Kingdom✨

The most fantastic part of this month-long event is that it’s only the beginning! Expect more news, collaborations, streams, giveaways and exciting activities, some of which coming up as soon as later today🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/ce5ea4da53e687c26d03ab5aa9447c07c115f511.png[/img]

[h2][b]Join us around a cozy fireplace - it’s story time with the devs✨[/b][/h2]

[i][h3]Immerse thyself in stories that transcend time, weaving a tapestry of magic and adventure. Let the written word be a lantern guiding you through the labyrinth of imagination.[/h3][/i]

[i]“Before all character sprites were done, we would put cats in the game as placeholders! My other favorite is the randomly rotating stuff... like when the mule just decides it walks on its face.”[/i] Alan, Game Designer

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/2ca753d7db6a729973166899518aab478efe4b9f.png[/img]

[i]“My fav bug is the one where you can get a duplicate dog. Two dogs. That’s a “not-a-bug-it’s-a-feature” bug, if I ever saw one.”[/i] Angelica, Experience Producer

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/016cca98585be0a4d7781938ca5c464a095013f0.jpg[/img]
[i]“Three winters ago, I joined the Kingdom team and one of the first things I got to do was play Kingdom Two Crowns in co-op together with Gordon Van Dyke. He taught me a Kingdom hack I never would have figured out on my own - if you upgrade your castle several levels fast, you get your first walls and wall upgrades for free! It was a privilege to learn from the best.”[/i] Elisabeth, Producer

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/912d95198d530111339faa65fb0c425a541ea18e.png[/img]

The thing I recently discovered is that, if presents drop near the Greed, they'll take those in place of a coin and it's actually so cute seeing a little Greed holding a present.”[/i] Vicki, Community Ambassador

notes.title: Lost Islands is Out!
notes.content:
[i]Once upon a time, there was a monarch who set sail on a journey to find the mysterious Lost Islands. Many had attempted this journey before, but few had returned. The only thing known about the island was it had a lighthouse built by the ancients and its location never the same.The monarch was determined to discover the secrets of the Lost Islands. They gathered a small crew of the bravest and most skilled citizens and set sail on their journey.

They sailed through treacherous storms, but they never gave up. They searched every inch of the ocean, but the Lost Islands seemed to elude them.

However, at long last, they see them; looking through their telescope, they witness the fabled Lost Islands. They shimmer and shift with the rise and fall of the sun, and even though the unknown stirs a little fear in their soul, the excitement of the adventure galvanizes them onwards.

Alas, they were never heard from again, just like all the others before them...[/i]

[b]Do you have what it takes to rule and conquer the Lost Islands? Download the free update to Kingdom Two Crowns to test your wits against the "Lost Islands" today![/b]

notes.title: Kingdom Q&A Roundup!
notes.content:
Welcome Monarchs, 

For those who were unable to attend, or those waiting for our words, hear ye! We bring you a little roundup of our Kingdom Q & A hosted on [url=https://discord.gg/rawfury]Discord[/url] in times past. 

This question-and-answer session was joined by: 

[list]
[*] Gordon (Game Director) 
[*] Elisabeth (Producer) 
[*] Vlado (Programmer) 
[*] Mariela (Brand Manager) 
[*] Fiona (Community Manager)
[/list] 
And now we begin! 👏 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/4b3152324df64a4abab87f4ce51d9540f2db14be.gif[/img]

[b]Q:[/b] Any thoughts for a future version with multiplayer 1v1? Who expands and conquers faster? 
[b]GordonVanDyke —  [/b]
It’s been discussed and I have a high-level design concept but it’s low on priority. 

[b]Q:[/b] Will you guys be making more merchandise that I can decorate my house with? 
[b]Elisabeth —  [/b]
We always want to explore more opportunities like that - we had a couple of cool event specific ones at Gamescom and PAX! What kind of merchandise would YOU like to see?  

[b]Q:[/b] Will there be a new game for co-op eighties? I know I already asked this question but I and most of my friends enjoyed playing the kingdom two crowns game and we will instantly buy the game if there is a co-op (multiplayer) option (btw the game still looks so fun will play it anyways) 
[b]Mariela — [/b]
We are not considering a co-op for Kingdom Eighties, but don't worry, we will keep supporting Kingdom Two Crowns So you will have the opportunity to enjoy new settings with your friends, along with discovering the story we've been writing for Eighties (where some secrets from Kingdom's lore will be revealed!). 

[b]Q:[/b] To Gordon (and the team really): How has it been to continue and expand over a concept like Kingdom? I've asked Thomas about it quite some time ago regarding Kingdom, and He told me he left because he felt there it was nothing else to do with the idea. For Him, Kingdom was something simple which (it seems) he never planned to expand upon. And yet Kingdom keeps on implementing significant little tweaks that change the flow of the game in different ways. Do you see the concept reaching some sort of ceiling? 
[b]GordonVanDyke — [/b] 
I’ve loved the challenge, the simplicity of the input with creating complex results from choices is what keep me and the team motivated. Thomas and I are still very close, he’s someone that builds new experiences and I thrive on expanding that experience. We always had great chemistry and we are very protective of the core design philosophy. I don’t see a see a ceiling per say, but I think Kingdom could feel dated at a certain point. We still have some cool stuff to come.  

[b]Q:[/b] Is there a reason you don't give your Cursed crown goals? It breaks immersion by forcing your players to look outside the game and then also be frustrated that there's not always a clear answer. It feels more like a slight to the players and makes me feel irrationally angry at whoever made the final call to not include it as a defined goal in gene. 
[b]Elisabeth — [/b]
We know that it can be frustrating, but it is part of the Kingdom experience. Just like with the units, puzzles, and buildings in the game, some players will figure their functions out on their own while some answers will need to be passed on from player to player. Not everyone will be able to get the cursed crown - it is supposed to be a special challenge for the most resolute and determined rulers. I hope you will keep trying! 

[b]Q:[/b] Is there a possibility that in the future, you may bring back some older tracks from New Lands and Classic OSTs into Two Crowns? 
[b]GordonVanDyke —  [/b]
No, mostly cause of how music contracts work.

notes.title: Patch Update 1.1.16
notes.content:
[i]"Ah, Monarchs!

Even though your Kingdom has been quiet lately, it's still a welcome sight to see you in full health. Your lands prosper through all the challenges you've overcome, and I can't even imagine what difficulties could hope to confron-"

Suddenly a storm picks up! It rushes through the fields, startling the mounts at the stable and knocking over many an archer. With it carries a voice on the wind.

[b]"Ha Ha Ha, oh mortals... So complacent. That's no fun at all."[/b]

As the storm settles, you trudge through your lands, clearing the debris whipped up from the wind; there's one location that stands undisturbed; whatever could this mean?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/be8fbfd0a389497a0881be9e480ff7a058476202.png[/img]

Hmm, well aside of some Shrine shenanigans, we also have some big news for you; there are now [b]new difficulty settings for Kingdom Two Crowns![/b] We heard you loud and clear when it came to different challenges for different folks, and we hope you enjoy setting up in peaceful or cursed lands. Thank you for being so patient in waiting for us to bring this feature. Please be sure to let us know what you think in the comments!

We'd love to see screenshots of your lands during these new settings or even play by plays of how you got through the toughest difficulty setting!

There are also some good balance changes and bug fixes listed below. If you encounter any issues or bugs, please get in touch with us via our [url=https://rawfury.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1] support desk [/url]

Now, onto our beautiful bullet points!

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added difficulty modes to Kingdom Two Crowns! You can now conquer your Kingdom in one of the following difficulty modes: Peaceful, Easy, Normal, Hard, and Cursed. The different modes will adjust the spawn rate of the Greed to your preference.
[*] [b]Norse Lands: [/b]There is something strange ab--ᛟᚢᛏ ᚦᛖ ᛊᛏᚨᚠᚠ ᚷᚱᚨᚾᛏᛖᛞ ᛒᛁ ᚦᛖ ᛚᛟᚲᛁ ᛊᚺᚱᛁᚾᛖ… ᚨᛊ ᛁᛟᚢ ᛈᛖᛖᚱ ᛁᚾᛏᛟ ᚦᛖ ᛊᛏᚨᚠᚠ ᛁᛟᚢ ᚲᚨᚾ ᚨᛚᛗᛟᛊᛏ ᚺᛖᚨᚱ ᚦᛖ ᚷᛟᛞ ᛟᚠ ᛗᛁᛊᚲᚺᛁᛖᚠ. ᛁᛊ ᚺᛖ… ᚲᚺᚢᚲᚲᛚᛁᛜ?
[*] [b]Norse Lands:[/b] The ghost will now teach new rulers how to purchase shields and activate the Shield wall.
[/list]

[b]Balance changes [/b]
[list]
[*] The game will now give you an extra moment to recover your crown (or dog, in Dire Island) before the game is lost. 
[*] Greed portals will not open as easily when the ruler gallops past them. 
[*] Ballista towers are now taller. Their arrows will strike true and no longer get stuck in walls as often. 
[*] Farms will now deploy farmlands more quickly.
[*] Small improvements to Knights and their Archers in combat. 
[/list]

[b]Global fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] We did another pass on patching up the coin purse - coins should no longer drop randomly without the ruler's consent. For real this time! (But do tell us if it still happens.)
[*] We also fixed an issue that would sometimes cause some coins to turn invisible when making a payment in co-op mode, and an issue that would sometimes cause Players 2’s coin purse to stop working.
[*] Your dog should no longer get so excited that it would sometimes disappear while howling at a blood moon.
[*] Fixed an issue that made it impossible to switch back to a steed that was previously used by the ruler.
[*] Fixed a bug where buildings would sometimes not spawn when revisiting an island in a later reign.
[*] Fixed an issue that would cause abandoned bomb barrels and fire barrels to never be used again. 
[*] Fixed several visual issues with the coat of arms.
[*] [b]Norse Lands:[/b] The Crusher Greed and the wild boar should now collide properly with the Kelpie’s ice wall ability. 
[*] [b]Norse Lands:[/b] Fixed several issues with Berserker potions and towers.
[*] [b]Norse Lands:[/b] Fixed an issue that would sometimes cause the ruler ability shrine to highlight and purchase a different item while the ruler is making a payment. 
[*] Minor visual improvements and bug fixes.
[/list]

[b]Multiplayer[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed several issues that could appear in online multiplayer with high latency. 
[/list]

Onward and safe travels! 👑

notes.title: Patch Update 1.1.14
notes.content:
Dear monarchs! 

Thank you so much for being patient whilst we worked through the bug reports and balance recommendations. As always, if you spot any other bugs, please feel free to contact us via our[url=https://rawfury.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1] support form. [/url]

Furthermore, we'd appreciate any feedback on the balance changes made. We read all your comments and feedback about some aspects of Norse Lands, and we hope we've addressed those causing the most problems. 

Here’s what’s new in patch 1.1.14:

[b]Norse Lands balance changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Norse Lands Bankers now have extended working hours.
[*] The tree in the Norse Lands Vagrant Camp has sadly died and been cut down.
[*] Monarchs can now pay for Shield Walls during the day, allowing for preparation for the night's attack.
[*] Reduced the cost for recruiting Berserkers and Berserker Leaders from 6/8 coins to 3/4 coins.
[*] Berserkers run faster, jump attack in combat, and have more hit points.
[*] Berserkers heal to full health after combat is over.
[*] The day 30 blood moon in Norse Lands is now a smaller attack focused on the introduction of the Crusher Greed.
[*] The winters of Norse Lands are proving too harsh for the Greed. Wave strength no longer increases during the first two winters.
[*] The Crusher greed will now retreat if there are no other Greed on the map, in order to prevent certain scenarios where the player could get soft-locked.
[/list]
[b]General balance changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the cost for recruiting citizens at the citizen house from 7 to 5 coins.
[*] Builders now walk back to the nearest Kingdom border when they have no more jobs to do.
[*] Large groups of Archers will now do a better job at defending the walls.
[*] Pikemen can now carry 2 coins.
[*] 
Plague Island has had a balance pass to adjust it to the fixes and balance changes made in the Conquest update.
[*] Improved the Archer retreat mechanic so they are more reliable about taking up positions in towers deep in the Kingdom.
[*] Masked trolls are a bit less effective against walls.
[*] Builders will leave their catapult to repair walls in the mornings.
[*] Breeders now throw catapult stones back less often.
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused antivirus software to block the game, in some cases causing a fatal error saying “il2cpp failed to load”. The game now has a signed certificate that should prevent this from happening.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused players with the system language set to Thai or Arabic to experience infinite saving or game freeze at campaign start. 
[*] More towers can now be built on each island, so the “I HAVE THE TOWER!” achievement should be easier to unlock. In order to access the new towers, you must start a new island or game.
[*] Adjusted the text for the “A journey is better shared” achievement to accurately reflect the unlock conditions.
[*] Fixed an issue that would cause the game to soft-lock when players paid for the Wall Horn in co-op. 
[*] Fixed an issue that caused some objects and Greed to fall off the map in a bottomless void, sometimes resulting in neverending blood moons. 
[*] Hermits should no longer jump off your mount at night if the Monarch is heading towards home.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused the shields of workers to flicker if they entered the Oil & Fire Tower. 
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused the wrong tower model to spawn in Dead Lands.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused the Forge to spawn below ground in Shogun.
[*] Fixed a bug where Norse Lands Berserkers would Rage continuously instead of attacking. 
[*] Fixed the monarch animation when riding the Sleipnir mount.
[*] Additional minor bug fixes and tweaks.
[/list]

Onward and safe travels! 👑

notes.title: Norse Lands Expansion and Conquest Update Arrive!
notes.content:
The waiting is over, for all of us! Thank you for the enthusiastic responses to the things we share. It gives us so much energy to put into the game. We hope you enjoy the results! 

Norse Lands fulfills an ambition of ours that has been building for a long time. The fiercely strong culture of the Norse from the Viking era feels like such a strong fit to the design of Kingdom. We really have had a blast putting it together. 

The Conquest Update pulls from all the feedback you have made and our learnings during development. Its improvements make this the best time ever to play Kingdom Two Crowns, whatever setting you choose, for new players and seasoned Monarchs.

To say we are excited to bring all this to you hardly describes the feelings. Here are a few thoughts from the game's director, Gordon Van Dyke on the development journey. 

[i]Norse Lands is the culmination of so much effort and exploration into everything that makes up Kingdom. A special partnership came together for the work between Fury Studios and Stumpy Squid, with the support of Raw Fury publishing.

Above all, the love and support of the Kingdom community inspired us every day. Without this we could not have persevered to  reach this triumphant moment for Kingdom Two Crowns. We hope all that love and passion shines through when you play and brings some joy into everyone’s lives.

Now, go forth, Monarchs, and conquer!
[/i]

And if you want to conquer together, because everyone knows co-op is awesome, check out this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/701160/discussions/0/5383485319911651273/]helpful post for two easy ways to connect with other Monarchs[/url].

Dear monarchs! Here’s what’s new in patch 1.1.12:

New biome - Norse Lands: Our first premium DLC is set in a domain inspired by Norse Viking culture 1000 C.E. Norse Lands is a full new campaign that expands the world of Kingdom Two Crowns with a unique setting to build, defend, explore, and conquer. In Norse Lands, players can look forward to unleashing abilities drawn upon from Norse gods, commanding mighty units, building Viking-inspired armaments, solving challenging puzzles, and facing a new enemy Greed.

Citizen house: Do you ever find yourself cutting down trees around vagrant camps and then instantly regretting the choices you’ve made? No need to worry! This patch allows you to build citizen houses from the ruins of a vagrant camp. There, you can always recruit new citizens to defend your Kingdom at an increased price.

Unit behavior changes
[list]
[*]Units will no longer attack portals unless ordered to do so.
[*]The Merchant will now payout at any time of day, but only accept payment to leave the Kingdom if it is safe.
[*]The Banker will now payout multiple times a day, so long as the player needs coins and the banker has coins.
[*]Archers will now only occupy the towers close to the border of your Kingdom or outside of your Kingdom. Additionally, they will no longer leave the safety of the Kingdom at night to try and enter towers.
[*]Speaking of Archers in towers: they now shoot further than archers on the ground, and they will hunt from the tower during the day.
[*]Up to eight Pikemen can now defend each border of your Kingdom.
[*]Vagrants will now turn into Peasants as soon as they finish eating bread. Rulers can still intercept them with coins to save on bread bills.
[*]Armored Greedlings are now stronger and tougher to defeat.
[*]Breeders now arrive on time with the rest of the wave, and retreat at dawn instead of dying.
[/list]
Blood Moon & Retaliation wave changes
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where Blood Moons would clear incorrectly, leaving your Kingdom vulnerable and without defenses at the end of the wave.
[*]Blood Moons and recovery days are now consistent throughout the game, getting more frequent the longer the game lasts. We also added a minor Blood Moon at the end of the first spring, so you’ll get used to it sooner ;)
[*]Daybreak will no longer end the onslaught from Blood Moons and Retaliation waves. Your Kingdom won’t be safe until every Greed has been defeated!
[*]Fixed lack of cooldown days after Blood Moons in the Dead Lands biome.
[*]Retaliation waves are not as punishing as fast, to allow Rulers more portal destruction action before being accidentally overwhelmed.
[*]Portal defense waves grow smoothly over time and become more difficult sooner. You'll need Knights to take portals in the late game because your Squires will die. That’s a promise!
[/list]
General improvements and bugfixes
[list]
[*]Ballista towers and catapults are now far more accurate and deadly.
[*]The Warhorse ability now triggers on your command and will not happen automatically when you sprint.
[*]We know you like to recruit a whole lot of archers and call it a day to feel safe and cozy within your Kingdom walls. Well, our designer Alan wants you to diversify your strategy with more types of units and towers. Your archer army may no longer stand up to the challenge!
[*]Decay should be more understandable and less punishing for heirs and returning rulers. Dropped gems no longer decay at all.
[*]Fixed an issue with challenge island data. Achieving the cursed crown in all challenges will once again result in your ruler wearing the cursed crown in the campaign. 
[*]Implemented support for wide and ultrawide screen resolutions.
[*]Fixed an issue with Korean translation.
[/list]
And more!

notes.title: The Conquest Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/1a3662ddb8072da8e695a08c791cb1316469f8b8.png[/img]

Monarchs! The free Conquest Update arrives Tuesday, Nov 16th, bringing with it a host of updates and improvements to all the settings of Kingdom Two Crowns (original, Shogun, and Dead Lands). Once installed, all changes will be in effect from both new games and existing saves. Here are some highlights to get you excited for and thinking about your next reign.

Firstly, the Citizen House. This new structure provides a solution for recruiting new citizens after clearing out a vagrant camp. Maybe you want to make a clean-looking kingdom. Perhaps you accidentally cleared around your last camp. Whatever the reason, vagrant camp ruins can now be rebuilt into a Citizen House. Once constructed, it will provide a ready source of new citizens, albeit at a higher cost.

Next, Archers! We told them to stop wandering out to towers at night. While we were at it, we encouraged them not to man towers that were really far from the borders either. They'll now abandon towers that end up too deep in your Kingdom and look for something useful to do. We kindly instructed them how to take advantage of their height to shoot farther, and they'll also hunt from their tower during the daytime now, making better use of their spare time. Don't get too overconfident in their improvements, as an all-archer army might not stand up as well as it used to.

Lastly, balance changes. Catapults and ballista towers have improved accuracy and damage (very satisfying in action). We refined the way Blood Moon and Retaliation waves work. They'll no longer clear incorrectly, leaving your Kingdom defenceless and vulnerable. Enemy waves will cycle between Blood Moons and recovery waves more consistently; expect Blood Moons to get more frequent as the game goes on. Greed now defend Portals with more fervour as well, and you can expect them to ramp up their response as you get further into the game: you're going to be needing those trusty knights!

Those are just a few gameplay highlights that we believe will vastly improve your experience. On top of gameplay changes, we have tech updates and upgrades. Let's just say players with wide and ultrawide monitors will get an improved overview of their Kingdom. Monarchs, prepare to reign over your best Kingdom ever.

Until next time, safe travels.

notes.title: Norse Lands and Conquest Update Available November 16
notes.content:
[h1]Norse Lands[/h1]

Norse Lands comes as a big moment for us. Living and working in Sweden the Scandinavian spirit runs strong. Its cultural heritage for survival and exploration felt like such a natural fit as we continued to explore new settings and cultures for the game. Everything finally aligned and we set about making a complete Viking experience drawn from those influences that keeps the core of what makes Kingdom fun.

The result is Norse Lands, a new full campaign inspired by the Viking culture of 1000 C.E.. Players can look forward to leading a strong people where everyone takes up arms to join the fight, unleash powers drawn from the legends of Norse gods, command mighty units, build Viking-inspired armaments, solve challenging puzzles, and face a new enemy type that has joined the Greed.

[previewyoutube=W9iuUJF08xc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Conquest Update[/h1]

During the development of Norse Lands we went through all your feedback and added it to our own wishlist for improvements to make in the game. This work resulted in a number of welcome changes and improvements that we wanted for all the settings in Kingdom Two Crowns. We’re calling it the Conquest update. It is a free update available to everyone with the game at the same time that Norse Lands comes out. 

Here are some things to look forward to. There is the new Citizen House that can be built on the ruins of a vagrant camp that gives you a ready supply of new citizens - at a cost of coin. The townspeople received coaching to address some of their annoying habits. As a result, they are now better at their jobs. Battle also sees refinements, including the pace of enemy waves, unit balance, decay, and this is just to name a few. Check out developer blog posts if you are interested in more details about the gameplay updates. The complete patch notes will be available shortly on the forums so keep an eye out for those as well.

Get ready, Monarch, your best Kingdom yet awaits.

notes.title: Meet the monarchs of Kingdom Two Crowns: Dead Lands
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/6f0b09e5e92e86cff79064dcb140481d6cd00db7.jpg[/img]

Building a Kingdom has never been darker with the new setting Dead Lands taking place in a gloomy mystical world with eerie mounts and spooky forests. And for the first time ever in Kingdom, players will not only be able to change their mounts as they explore and expand their Kingdom but they’ll also be able to switch between four different monarchs, each with a powerful and unique trait. These four new playable characters all come directly from the gothic horror action-RPG [i]Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night[/i].

[h2]Miriam[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/d80eb38cfedad67034a373830c8ef25f60f794af.gif[/img]

Miriam is the main protagonist in [i]Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night[/i] and the first playable monarch in Kingdom Two Crowns: Dead Lands before unlocking the other Bloodstained characters.

As an orphan Miriam was turned into a Shardbinder at a young age. Shardbinders are afflicted with a curse by Alchemists that slowly crystallizes their skin and gives them the ability to control demonic powers embedded in the crystals. She is deeply pained by the suffering of humankind caused by a long-time friend.

[b]Kingdom Two Crowns Ability: [/b]A whip lash that sends out a powerful wave which freezes the Greed and stops their movement for a short duration. 

[h2]Zangetsu[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/c6539ad33c61f85025ca90580137a67e9dbf8d97.gif[/img]

A Demon Hunter who originated from a country in the East. Master at wielding a katana, Zangetsu specializes in fighting demons and has dedicated his life fending off the demons that walk the earth. He has lost many friends, along with losing his left eye and right arm during his long journey of keeping the demons at bay.

[b]Kingdom Two Crowns Ability:[/b] Raising his katana rallies the nearby Archers, Pikemen and Knights to increase their attack speed for a short time.  

[h2]Alfred[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/844c77da860690dc25dbd1efe59c38946d8ef6a5.gif[/img]

Alfred is a soft-spoken, creative, and wise man who is fully equipped with powerful alchemic abilities that is unmatched among his fellow alchemists. A father figure to Miriam.

[b]Kingdom Two Crowns Ability: [/b]Conjures a duplicate of himself and his steed that doubles his powers. The duplicate doesn’t take damage by the Greed or other hostile forest creatures. 

[h2]Gebel[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/c88eccd38ddb89386f692aba9b8747ee3e5e3143.gif[/img]

Gebel is a Sharbinder and long-time friend of Miriam. Apart from Miriam, he is the last surviving Shardbinder who was able to withstand the effects of the experiments done to him at such a severe level. 

[b]Kingdom Two Crowns Ability:[/b] Gebel can take the form of a bat which allow him to fly fast and deceive the Greed. After a short period of time as a bat he reappears on his steed.

W or Arrow Up-key[/b]

Since the launch of micro-strategy game Kingdom Two Crowns, monarchs have been building their Kingdoms in the classic medieval and feudal Japan-inspired settings. Now things are about to get darker and creepier with Dead Lands, a completely new setting that will change how you rule your Kingdom and overcome the Greed. Taking place in a gloomy mystical world with eerie mounts, building a Kingdom has never been more frightening than this! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/2b490b16e7bf01389b160514f69613adcf4c966b.gif[/img]

For the first time ever in Kingdom, players will not only be able to change their mounts as they explore and expand their Kingdom but they’ll also be able to switch between four different monarchs, each with a powerful and unique trait. These four new playable characters all come directly from the gothic horror action-RPG Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night and include Shardbinder Miriam and three unlockable characters—demon hunter Zangetsu, summoner Gebel and alchemist Alfred. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967186/337c07aa2a156a089572e243a077cc5135debcbc.jpg[/img]

Published globally by 505 Games, Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night was created by legendary game developer Koji “IGA” Igarashi and his studio ArtPlay. The cover illustration for Kingdom Two Crowns: Dead Lands, with Miriam riding the mythic demon horse Gamigin, is drawn by ArtPlay’s Mana Ikeda, who created the original package illustration for Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night.

Kingdom Two Crowns: Dead Lands is a free update coming April 28th to Kingdom Two Crowns.

notes.title: Kingdom Two Crowns: Winter Update
notes.content:
Dear Monarchs!

We’d like to thank everyone that eagerly built their kingdoms spanning across many lands, each filled with secrets to be discovered. As your kingdoms expanded for each passing day, the seasons were passing as well. Eventually winter comes, which can be very harsh if your coffers are empty, making you hunker down behind safety of the walls as the Greed descend upon your Kingdom to pillage during the night. In the previous game Kingdom: New Lands, the intention was to escape the land with winter being the end state. In Kingdom Two Crowns however you must persevere through winter to spring and end the Greed. However, there is good news, the citizens have discovered new ways to be more active during winter allowing for more options to continue your plight against the Greed. Read below for more details:

[list]
[*] [b]Hunting during winter: [/b]While the smaller animals go into winter hibernation, there’s other animals that suddenly appear as the snow starts falling on the ground. But beware that you must first find this menacing animal deep in the forest, and once confronted it’s much tougher than the regular small game that roamed outside the walls of your kingdom during spring, summer and autumn.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hP7X8aU.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Foraging during winter:[/b] Since the farms can’t harvest during winter, the Farmers have discovered foraging to bring in a bit of extra income. It’s not much but every bit helps.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OrQTcTY.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Shinobi:[/b] Who says being a stealth warrior at night is all we’re good for?! During long nights of waiting in ambush the Shinobi came up with a brilliant way to pass time during the day instead of just sleeping.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vp1hJBh.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Introducing the Gem Chest:[/b] Those gems sure are a heavy burden to carry around while you explore for valuable upgrades to use gems on. Now you can lighten your purse and store the gems in a stone chest. This appears by the Wharf once you’ve upgraded your Kingdom to a Stone Castle. Storing gems is a costly business, so it won’t be free for the Monarch to offload those precious gems.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32967186/98f9dc94609f16643dbfef7acfa83f8d34f5f1db.png[/img]

[*] [b]Other updates:[/b] In addition to the above there’s also fixes and changes such as an upgrade to the Stable to make switch Steeds more affordable, improving appearance of shops on the edge of your kingdom walls as you expand, and optimisation of save data compression, to mention a few. We have also included Brazilian-Portuguese as a language option and improved the Russian text.
[/list]

[b]SteamOS (Linux)[/b]
Kingdom Two Crowns is coming soon to Linux. For eager monarchs, there’s a beta branch that can be tested on Steam. Please provide us with feedback and reports bugs by [url=https://rawfury.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1]using this form[/url].

[b]What holds the future for Kingdom Two Crowns?[/b]
In the immediate future there will be more quality of life updates like this Winter update. We promised new locations similar to the Japanese setting in Shogun. These will be coming later down the road and all we can say is that it will be worth the wait! But before venturing into completely new lands, there will be an update with Challenge Islands. These offer an alternative experience to the campaign with a tougher roguelike gameplay and custom rules. More on that later. Now venture forth and overthrow the Greed!

notes.content:

Greetings Monarchs! 

This is a long-awaited patch! We hoped we would be able to push this patch live earlier, but we decided to wait and get all the important bug fixes in before releasing. We plan to patch Kingdom Two Crowns more regularly in the coming weeks. We really hope you will enjoy this patch. 

[h1]Features:[/h1][list]
[*]Added Wharf Bell to the boat docks which allows the player to manually call citizens to the boat. Removing the feature that citizens are called to the boat as soon as it’s put in the water.
[*]Changed the notification of the crown stealer spawn.[/list]

[h1]Balance:[/h1][list]
[*]Lowered the coin price of the ninja.
[*]Doubled the amount of hits the ninja can take.
[*]Doubled the amount of attacks pikemen can do.
[*]Adjusted speed of crown stealer so that they now stay with the pack of greed instead of running ahead.[/list]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1][list]
[*] Fixed issues with achievements “There is No Greater Ruler Than Thou”, “Their Saviour” and “Never Gives Up”.
[*] Fixed an instance where the game could not save the progress properly thereby displaying an error prompt. Issue should now be fixed, and error prompt should no longer be displayed.
[*] Fixed an issue where the host player could get a soft lock when toggling “Joinable state” to off while a client player was connecting.
[*] Fixed so player no longer can get stuck in opening point of game if enabling online joining if there is no internet connection.
[*]“Beggars” should now spawn properly even in long sessions.
[*]Workers and archers should now perform assigned tasks properly even in long sessions.
[*]Hermits will now properly board the boat if they are purchased just before the monarch boards the boat.
[*]Forge now spawns as designed.
[*]Crown status in multiplayer sessions will now persists across islands.
[*]Tools such as the scythes should no longer bounce around for client players.
[*]Fix for Shogun Kirin mount turning into unicorn mount when switching islands.
[*]Client player should no longer get stuck in loading screen if accepting an invite from a host player which are in the tutorial.
[*]Thickets should now spawn properly.
[*]Fixed so that in-game music does not play over credits music when viewing credits. [/list]

Once again, we would like to say thank you to all the monarchs who have helped us track and identify these bugs.

As always, if you run in to any pesky issues, you can always reach out to us via our [url=https://rawfury.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1]Raw Fury Helpdesk[/url]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where an infinite loading screen could occur if the connection failed when attempting to join a Steam friend
[*] Fixed an issue involving the Stables and multiplayer games (aka Steed Save Corruption) - this will also patch affected save data, so you shouldn't need to restart your campaign
[*] Added a fix for corrupted, almost empty save data, that was sometimes caused by having a connection attempt fail with very particular timing
[*] Fixed an issue that caused pikemen to fish double money when in an online game
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the bow and hammer shops to be unusable by the client, if they joined after the scythe shop had been placed
[*] Fixed that hermits would wander outside of the kingdom, searching for a place to stand, to their eventual demise
[*] Fixed that workers would also wander outside of the walls during greed attacks
[*] Fixed an unlock requirement for the 'There is No Greater Ruler Than Thou' achievement
[*] Fixed an issue where swapping steeds spawned by the Stables repeatedly in an online game could cause ridden steeds to move independently
[*] Fixed an issue with having hermits as passengers when a remote client pays to embark on the boat[/list]

[h1]Balance: [/h1]
[list][*] Buffed the ninja, and reduced the hire cost
[*] Reduced a few steeds' ride costs (Bear, Stamina Horse, Unicorn/Kirin, Lizard and Warhorse)[/list]

[h1]Features: [/h1]
[list][*] Added a way for players to manually dismount their hermit passengers (flip back and forth rapidly to expel unwanted hermits)
[*] Updated the credits[/list]

We are still working hard on fixing critical issues like:
[list][*] Knights not attacking portals if player arrived in an intact boat
[*] Blacksmith/Catapult shop not appearing
[*] Items rotating when purchased by clients
[*]  Difficulty to find co-op controls
[*] Bread from the bakery disappearing [/list]

Please note that you will need to start a new campaign for the game to properly generate the balance changes into your Kingdom. In order to do that follow these steps:
[list][*] Allow your current game to load
[*] Open the menu
[*] Select "Campaign"
[*] Select a blank campaign save
[*] Enjoy the changes![/list]

Once again, we would like to say thank you to all the monarchs who have helped us track and identify these bugs. We will continue to work diligently on Kingdom Two Crowns and the big 2019 QoL patch. Happy Holidays!

Hi Monarchs!

We wanted to share some of the things we collected from your feedback so far that we will try our best to get in the first big update. This is planned to release early next year (2019). Even if some don't make the first Update we will get them in at some point. We have two big free content updates planned for 2019 and one more big QoL in 2019.

[h1]From your feedback[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improve Winter experience
[*] Improve Hermit behavior
[*] Improve Ninja's value
[*] Make switching Steeds less costly
[*] Increase Pikemen health i.e. how many successful attacks they can perform before spear breaks)
[*] Add a way to recover lost gems
[*] Improve initiating Coop splitscreen experience
[*] Improve outer wall units shop location i.e. shops move outward with expansion of walls.
[/list]

[i]We will continue to add to this list, once we've reached our bandwidth we'll add more to the next big update.[/i]

[h1]Already in Planning and very likely to make it into the QoL #01 Update[/h1]
[list]
[*] Introduce the Challenge Islands
[*] Add SteamOS (Linux) Support
[*] Add Original Ruler DLC for all owners of Kingdom: Classic and Kingdom: New Lands

[/list]

notes.title: Kingdom Two Crowns is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Legends tell of a group of isles ripe with hidden treasure, mysterious artifacts from a long ago civilization, and the abundant resources necessary to foster a burgeoning Kingdom. Venture forth, fortify your domain, and endeavor to tame these strange lands for who knows what lurks in the dark neighboring forests beyond your borders…

Welcome to [i]Kingdom Two Crowns[/i], the most ambitious entry in our celebrated [i]Kingdom[/i] series which has been enjoyed by over 3 million monarchs. A brand new campaign mode, exclusive mounts and NPCs, and an entirely new feudal Japan-themed setting with its own unique NPCs and strategies are just a taste of what this latest installment has to offer. And for the first time, you can play [i]Kingdom [/i]alongside a friend as we introduce co-op to the experience.

https://youtu.be/GnqjjY38anQ

[i]Kingdom [/i]was the first game we ever published, a simultaneously wonderful and terrifying experiment as we ventured into indie publishing for the first time, and being able to continue building upon that inaugural success years later has been a dream. We hope that you’ll see the careful crafting and diligence we’ve put into [i]Kingdom Two Crowns[/i], it has a special place in our hearts and our hope is that it finds a little corner of your own.
